title: Forty-two years with Ory's band and the Orson Welles broadcasts
summary: Garland lists the Ory band with Mutt Carey, Darensbourg, Wilson, Noone and Zutty Singleton, who played for Welles, and Turetsky notes how rare such longevity is.
